My memory doesn't hold that. I have no record of you asking to pause work on the Mac, or of a reason or a duration for it.

The nearest thing I remember is the machine-pause feature. It was built by leaf 0f8dfe94 and is the only interrupt path, and it's on main as 24a424ba6. The follow-up that stops running commands on pause is c2d7695b3, migration 0177_machine_pause_stopped. Those are about the feature, not a pause you requested.

If you did ask, it was either before my summary or in a message that didn't make it in. I'd rather not guess at a reason or a length. Tell me what you want paused and for how long, or I can check the hub's pause records.
